`dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` (called from the handler via `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, line 15–17, which delegates to `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` at line 48); the `internal/webhook` package performs HTTP delivery (`webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`); signing is HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body`, base64-encoded and sent in `webhook-signature` as `v1,<sig>` alongside `webhook-id` and `webhook-timestamp` headers (Svix-style signing) — `internal/webhook/webhook.go:133–149`.

Note: memo creation reaches this via `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`; the per-webhook fan-out and payload construction happen in `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, which loops the user's webhooks and calls `webhook.PostAsync` (line 71).
